layers.what_it_tests: Recall: all 13 planted vuln classes CONFIRMED. Precision: all 7 benign controls REJECTED. Runs the real template→check→5-gate-verify path against a live testbed.

excluded_from_suite.reason: Calls live LLM (run_reflexes → ollama) — hangs without a running model. Needs --live flag guard before inclusion.

templates.what_it_finds: Old API version still routable while new version is the contract
Privileged-named endpoint may not enforce the identity its name claims
GraphQL introspection live — full schema self-discloses
Fuzzed input → HTTP 500, unhandled exception leaks internals
Two URL spellings for the same route — auth middleware may bind to only one
Legacy/backup paths still routable, escape current access policy
Health/metrics/debug endpoint leaks versions, keys, environment
API keys or tokens shipped in client-side JS bundle
Full OpenAPI/Swagger spec publicly served — full route enumeration
Redirect/callback flow with client-controlled target — unvalidated redirect
Server trusts client-injectable header (X-Original-Role) as role proof
Guarded path returns 403; alternate path serves identical data with no auth
Dependency manifests, lockfiles, docker/IaC files served publicly
Config file declares one value; code lives a different value
Function marked deprecated is still invoked in live code

verifier_gates.gate_1: Grounding — check URL host must appear in recon data (exact match, no lookalikes)
verifier_gates.gate_2: Scope — bounty program rules enforced by ProgramScopeGate, fails closed on exception
verifier_gates.gate_3: Expected — card must state a machine-readable status code
verifier_gates.gate_4: Claim source — assertion_a_source must be non-empty
verifier_gates.gate_5: Wire — observed status + body predicates + header predicates must all match
verifier_gates.note: Gate 4 currently accepts any non-empty string (recon filename). Tightening to require a policy-document citation is a known open item.

oracle_hunter.py.note: Full pipeline: recon → seams → verify → PoC → report

oracle_programs.py.note: Multi-platform discovery: HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti, YesWeHack, Immunefi, others

oracle_llm.py.note: Backend router: CLI agents → OpenRouter → local Ollama, cascading

oracle_email.py.note: Gmail via CDP (no OAuth), approval queue, Oracle-voice drafting

oracle_scope_gate.note: In oracle_hunter.py — ProgramScopeGate, path-scoped exclusions, global CDN blocklist

open_gaps.what: No test proves ffuf + wordlist actually finds the planted routes against a live testbed
open_gaps.how_to_close: Spin up vuln_testbed_full.py, run ffuf with oracle-api-paths.txt, assert vuln routes appear in output

open_gaps.what: No end-to-end test: oracle-hunter analyze <recon-dir> → mocked LLM → finding card out
open_gaps.how_to_close: Mock oracle_llm.complete() to return a canned seam card, run full analyze path, assert CONFIRMED card emitted

open_gaps.what: test_oracle_ground_truth.py hangs — calls live LLM with no timeout guard
open_gaps.how_to_close: Split: deterministic-verify half runs always; LLM half skipped unless ORACLE_LIVE_LLM=1 env var set

open_gaps.what: assertion_a_source accepts any non-empty string; designed to require a real policy-document citation
open_gaps.how_to_close: Restrict to known source types: 'program_policy', 'scope_doc', or a real file path; reject free-form labels

open_gaps.what: No chaining pass: two CONFIRMED seams that compose into higher severity are not combined
open_gaps.how_to_close: After verify, run one compose pass on CONFIRMED-only cards; build chain only from proven links

critical_path_to_first_submission.step_1: oracle-hunter list --web2 --min-payout 500  →  pick low-report, fast-triage, real web assets
critical_path_to_first_submission.step_2: oracle-hunter seams <recon-dir>  →  deterministic templates run, no LLM needed, get CANDIDATE cards
critical_path_to_first_submission.step_3: oracle-hunter hunt <program>  →  full pipeline: recon + verify → CONFIRMED cards
critical_path_to_first_submission.step_4: oracle-hunter draft <recon-dir>  →  submission_draft.md in Oracle voice
critical_path_to_first_submission.note: Templates + 5-gate verifier need NO LLM. A CONFIRMED card from step 2/3 is submittable today.
critical_path_to_first_submission.fastest_path: Run seams-only on a real program recon dir — if any card CONFIRMS, submit it
